summary: Frontend-only marketing site for Executive Sales Leadership Network tested end-to-end via Playwright against public preview URL. All 18 requested features verified working: hero headline, sticky navbar with backdrop blur, hero CTAs (invite dialog + explore scroll), hero metrics (5,000+/300+/120+/₹10,000 Cr+), WhyJoin 6 cards, 5 leader names, 6 platform features, 3 events, 3 membership tiers with correct prices and MOST POPULAR badge, testimonial slider (prev/next/dots), stats counters, FinalCTA apply+schedule opening correct dialog modes, sonner toast 'Application received' on form submit, mobile hamburger toggle at 390px. Data-testid coverage is excellent across all interactive elements.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar Sign-In button (data-testid='navbar-explore-btn') actually opens the invite dialog via onCta — testid name is misleading ('explore' implies scroll, but it is wired to invite). Consider renaming to 'navbar-signin-btn' for clarity.
RequestInviteDialog uses setTimeout (900ms) as simulated submit — acceptable per spec (no backend), clearly documented.
Hero image uses external Unsplash URLs with large query params — fine for marketing site but consider lazy-loading for performance.
No 404/fallback route in App.js Routes — only path '/' is defined. Not required per spec but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: ~100% (all 18 requested features work; 37/38 Playwright assertions passed; the 1 transient 'testimonial next' miss was a 700ms timing artifact during AnimatePresence exit — verified manually via screenshot that next IS working since Anjali Sharma (index 1) rendered after click; dot-2 navigation also passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Site deployed at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://creo-network-india.preview.emergentagent.com). Pure static React marketing site using framer-motion, sonner toasts, shadcn/ui Dialog. No backend/API/auth. All key interactive elements have data-testid. Sonner toast matches via [data-sonner-toast] selector. Mobile breakpoint at 1024px (lg:hidden on hamburger).
rca of the issue: No real bugs found. The one Playwright assertion that reported FAIL ('testimonial-next works: t1 count=0') is a false-negative caused by AnimatePresence mode='wait' — during the 700ms wait after click, the component was in exit-transition and the newly keyed motion.div had not yet mounted with testid 'testimonial-1'. Longer wait or polling would resolve. The functionality itself works (verified via subsequent testimonial-dot-2 success and screenshot showing Anjali Sharma/index-1 after next click).
